description: This Java source file defines the ModelGroupReader class, responsible for reading and caching entity group definitions from XML configuration files within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages resource handlers for entity group XML files, parses them to build mappings between entity names and their groups, and provides APIs to retrieve group names, entity names by group, and related data.

classes.name: ModelGroupReader
classes.description: Reader class for entity group definitions, responsible for caching and retrieving entity group mappings from XML configuration files.

methods.name: getModelGroupReader
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a ModelGroupReader instance based on a delegator name, using a cache for singleton behavior.

methods.name: getGroupCache
methods.description: Loads and caches the entity-to-group mappings from the XML resource files if not already cached.

methods.name: getEntityGroupName
methods.description: Returns the group name for a given entity name, defaulting to the delegator's default group if not explicitly mapped.

methods.name: getGroupNames
methods.description: Returns a set of all group names defined for a specific delegator, including the default group.

methods.name: getEntityNamesByGroup
methods.description: Returns a set of entity names that belong to a specified group within a delegator.
